Maintenance is scheduled for Sunday, 20 September 2026, from 02:00 to 02:30 UTC. The dashboard will be unavailable during this window. The API and scheduled jobs will continue to operate. No customer action is needed.

Status updates will be posted at https://status.example.test. Completion before 02:30 UTC is not guaranteed.
